# Facebook Page connector

Go connector for publishing and managing content on a Facebook Page through the Meta Graph API: feed posts, photos, videos, scheduling, comments, and insights. Generated from a curated OpenAPI spec authored from the official Meta documentation (Meta publishes no OpenAPI spec).

## How to use this connector

One `Client` serves one Facebook Page and needs a **Page access token**
(permissions: `pages_manage_posts`, `pages_read_engagement`,
`pages_show_list`). If you only have a user token, construct a client
with it, call `ListManagedPages`, and use the returned `AccessToken` of
the target page in a second client:

```go
import (
    "github.com/pax-beehive/connector"
    "github.com/pax-beehive/connector/facebook"
)

c, err := facebook.NewClient(&facebook.Config{
    AccessToken: "EAAG...", // page access token
    // Version: "v23.0",    // Graph API version override
})

// Text/link post:
post, err := c.CreatePagePost(ctx, &facebook.CreatePagePostRequest{
    PageId:  pageID,
    Message: connector.Ptr("Hello from the API"),
})

// Photo from a public URL:
photo, err := c.CreatePagePhoto(ctx, &facebook.CreatePagePhotoRequest{
    PageId:  pageID,
    Url:     connector.Ptr("https://example.com/photo.jpg"),
    Message: connector.Ptr("caption"),
})

// Scheduled post: Published=false + ScheduledPublishTime (Unix, 10 min
// to 30 days ahead).
```

## Auth model

- Every request sends `Authorization: Bearer <AccessToken>`.
- Tokens are NOT auto-refreshed; page tokens derived from a long-lived
  user token do not expire in normal use, but re-issuing them happens
  outside this SDK.

## Errors

Non-2xx responses become `*connector.APIError`; `Code` is the Graph error
`code` (plus `/subcode` when present, e.g. `190` = invalid/expired token,
`200` = permissions error), `Message` is Meta's message.

## Data conventions

- GET endpoints return only the fields you list in `Fields`
  (comma-separated); omit it and Meta returns a minimal default set.
- `Since`/`Until`/`ScheduledPublishTime` are Unix timestamps (int64).
  Response timestamps parse Meta's `+0000`-style offsets into
  `connector.DateTime`.
- Pagination: pass `After`/`Before` cursors from `Paging.Cursors`.

## Capability boundaries (what this connector does NOT do)

- No OAuth flow: obtaining/exchanging tokens happens outside this SDK
  (except listing page tokens via `ListManagedPages`).
- No media file uploads: photos/videos publish from public URLs only
  (no resumable/chunked upload).
- No Stories/Reels publishing, Groups, Events, Messenger, ads, or
  webhooks.
- No rate limiting or automatic retries.
